WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, w.net_amount AS amt
  FROM web_lines w JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar p ON w.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN web_lines w ON w.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
),
combined AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt END)/sum(amt),2) AS cc_share_net_of_returns,
  sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt END) cc, sum(amt) tot,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND amt>0 THEN amt END)/sum(CASE WHEN amt>0 THEN amt END),2) AS cc_share_before_returns
FROM combined WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2

  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
